question.text: 'Separately Managed Accounts' (SMAs) are a carve-out from:

answer.text: The hedge fund/Cat III fund structure, holding assets separately

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.3.1.1, SMAs are carve-outs from fund structures — holding assets separately for each client. The Trap: They are not broker or MF constructs. Cross-Exam Context: Common in US hedge fund industry. Distributor's Pro-Tip: If a client insists on direct asset ownership, SMA through PMS (not Cat III) may be a better fit.
